# cloudtower_vlan (Resource)

CloudTower VM VLAN resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudtower_vds" "my_vds" {
  name = "management"
}

resource "cloudtower_vlan" "my_vlan" {
  name    = "my-vlan"
  vds_id  = data.cloudtower_vds.my_vds.vds[0].id
  vlan_id = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VLAN's name
- `vds_id` (String) The ID of the VDS this VLAN belongs to

### Optional

- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID (0-4095)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VLAN's ID
- `local_id` (String) VLAN's local ID
- `type` (String) VLAN's network type
